evidence: The ALD cycle consisted of (a) TMA-precursor injection (1 s); (b) N 2 purge (3 s); (c) oxygen-precursor injection (3 s for H 2O and 6 s for O 3); and (d) N2 purge (2 s after the H 2O pulse, 4 s after the O3 pulse). Note that the O 3 pulse is always longer than the H 2O one. For all the films, 212 ALD cycles were applied.
